problem_statement:
I want the friendship model API to treat a stored friendship row as a bidirectional relationship between two Django users. The library should expose `Friendship.objects.friends_for_user(user)`, returning a list of dictionaries where each item has `friend` set to the other `User` and `friendship` set to the matching `Friendship` record. For example, if there is one row with `from_user=alice` and `to_user=bob`, `friends_for_user(alice)` should include `{"friend": bob, "friendship": that_row}` and `friends_for_user(bob)` should include `{"friend": alice, "friendship": that_row}`.

I also need `Friendship.objects.are_friends(user1, user2) -> bool` to answer true regardless of storage direction. With the same `alice` to `bob` row, both `are_friends(alice, bob)` and `are_friends(bob, alice)` should return `True`; for a user pair with no row in either direction, it should return `False`.

I need `Friendship.objects.remove(user1, user2)` to remove the matching `Friendship` row without the caller knowing which user was stored as `from_user`. If the row is stored as `from_user=alice, to_user=bob`, calling either `remove(alice, bob)` or `remove(bob, alice)` should remove that row from the database.

Please also provide `friend_set_for(user) -> set[User]` as a convenience helper over the manager lookup. For the `alice` to `bob` row, `friend_set_for(alice)` should return `{bob}` and `friend_set_for(bob)` should return `{alice}`.

When a `Friendship` instance is removed through the ORM, any `FriendshipInvitation` rows with the same `from_user` and `to_user` should have `status` set to `"8"` unless they are already marked that way. This cleanup should happen as part of removing the friendship record so callers using `Friendship.objects.remove(...)` or removing the model instance get consistent invitation status updates.

+++ b/usercase-test-coderl/test_bidirectional_friendship.py
@@ -0,0 +1,257 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+import pytest
+
+from django.conf import settings
+
+
+if not settings.configured:
+    settings.configure(
+        SECRET_KEY="fixture-friendship",
+        INSTALLED_APPS=[
+            "django.contrib.auth",
+            "django.contrib.contenttypes",
+            "django.contrib.sites",
+            "friends",
+        ],
+        DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
+        USE_TZ=True,
+        DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
+        SITE_ID=1,
+        SITE_NAME="Example",
+        CONTACT_EMAIL="contact@example.test",
+        DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL="noreply@example.test",
+    )
+
+import django
+
+django.setup()
+
+from django.apps import apps
+from django.contrib.auth.models import User
+from django.db import connection
+from django.db.models.query import QuerySet
+
+from friends.models import Friendship, FriendshipInvitation, FriendshipInvitationHistory, friend_set_for
+
+
+_original_select_related = QuerySet.select_related
+
+
+def _select_related_compat(self, *fields, **kwargs):
+    kwargs.pop("depth", None)
+    return _original_select_related(self, *fields, **kwargs)
+
+
+QuerySet.select_related = _select_related_compat
+
+
+with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
+    for model in apps.get_models():
+        schema_editor.create_model(model)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def clean_database():
+    Friendship.objects.all().delete()
+    FriendshipInvitation.objects.all().delete()
+    FriendshipInvitationHistory.objects.all().delete()
+    User.objects.all().delete()
+    yield
+    Friendship.objects.all().delete()
+    FriendshipInvitation.objects.all().delete()
+    FriendshipInvitationHistory.objects.all().delete()
+    User.objects.all().delete()
+
+
+def make_user(pk, username):
+    return User.objects.create(id=pk, username=username)
+
+
+def friend_rows_for(user):
+    return [
+        (
+            item["friend"].id,
+            item["friend"].username,
+            item["friendship"].id,
+            item["friendship"].from_user.username,
+            item["friendship"].to_user.username,
+        )
+        for item in Friendship.objects.friends_for_user(user)
+    ]
+
+
+def test_friends_for_user_returns_the_other_user_from_either_storage_direction():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(101, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(102, "bob")
+    carol = make_user(103, "carol")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=201, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+
+    assert friend_rows_for(alice) == [(102, "bob", 201, "alice", "bob")]
+    assert friend_rows_for(bob) == [(101, "alice", 201, "alice", "bob")]
+    assert friend_rows_for(carol) == []
+
+
+def test_are_friends_answers_true_both_ways_and_false_for_absent_pairs():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(111, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(112, "bob")
+    carol = make_user(113, "carol")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=211, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(alice, bob) is True
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(bob, alice) is True
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(alice, carol) is False
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(carol, alice) is False
+
+
+def test_remove_forward_order_deletes_the_matching_friendship_row():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(121, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(122, "bob")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=221, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 1
+    Friendship.objects.remove(alice, bob)
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(alice, bob) is False
+    assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(bob, alice) is False
+
+
+def test_remove_reverse_order_deletes_row_and_marks_same_direction_invitation_deleted():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(131, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(132, "bob")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=231, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+    same_invitation = FriendshipInvitation.objects.create(id=331, from_user=alice, to_user=bob, message="same direction", status="2")
+    reverse_invitation = FriendshipInvitation.objects.create(id=332, from_user=bob, to_user=alice, message="reverse direction", status="2")
+
+
+    assert (same_invitation.status, reverse_invitation.status) == ("2", "2")
+    Friendship.objects.remove(bob, alice)
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
+    same_invitation.refresh_from_db()
+    reverse_invitation.refresh_from_db()
+
+    assert (same_invitation.status, reverse_invitation.status) == ("8", "2")
+
+
+def test_friend_set_for_returns_the_bidirectional_user_set():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(141, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(142, "bob")
+    carol = make_user(143, "carol")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=241, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+
+    assert sorted((user.id, user.username) for user in friend_set_for(alice)) == [(142, "bob")]
+    assert sorted((user.id, user.username) for user in friend_set_for(bob)) == [(141, "alice")]
+    assert sorted((user.id, user.username) for user in friend_set_for(carol)) == []
+
+
+def test_remove_without_a_matching_row_does_not_create_or_delete_friendships():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(151, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(152, "bob")
+
+    try:
+        Friendship.objects.remove(alice, bob)
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
+
+
+def test_cleanup_leaves_already_deleted_invitation_status_at_8_on_repeated_cleanup_paths():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(161, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(162, "bob")
+    invitation = FriendshipInvitation.objects.create(id=361, from_user=alice, to_user=bob, message="already deleted", status="8")
+
+    first = Friendship.objects.create(id=261, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+    first.delete()
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
+    invitation.refresh_from_db()
+
+    assert invitation.status == "8"
+
+    second = Friendship.objects.create(id=262, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+    second.delete()
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
+    invitation.refresh_from_db()
+
+    assert invitation.status == "8"
+
+
+def test_two_friendship_pairs_keep_independent_state_after_one_pair_is_removed():
+
+
+
+
+    alice = make_user(171, "alice")
+    bob = make_user(172, "bob")
+    carol = make_user(173, "carol")
+    dana = make_user(174, "dana")
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=271, from_user=alice, to_user=bob)
+    Friendship.objects.create(id=272, from_user=carol, to_user=dana)
+
+    assert friend_rows_for(alice) == [(172, "bob", 271, "alice", "bob")]
+    assert friend_rows_for(carol) == [(174, "dana", 272, "carol", "dana")]
+
+    Friendship.objects.remove(alice, bob)
+
+    assert friend_rows_for(alice) == []
+    assert friend_rows_for(bob) == []
+    assert friend_rows_for(carol) == [(174, "dana", 272, "carol", "dana")]
+    assert friend_rows_for(dana) == [(173, "carol", 272, "carol", "dana")]
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 1
+
+
+def test_friendship_row_count_stays_bounded_across_many_remove_cycles():
+
+
+
+
+    for offset in range(120):
+        left = make_user(1000 + offset * 2, "left-%03d" % offset)
+        right = make_user(1001 + offset * 2, "right-%03d" % offset)
+        Friendship.objects.create(from_user=left, to_user=right)
+        assert Friendship.objects.are_friends(right, left) is True
+        Friendship.objects.remove(right, left)
+
+    assert Friendship.objects.count() == 0
